name: Mogetius

attributes.attribute: identified by the Romans with Mars
read as Mars Mogetius in one form

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mogetius is a Continental Celtic god. He is an obscure god mentioned in two inscriptions. The Romans identified Mogetius with their deity of war, Mars. In one record the name appears as Mogetius Mars. The name belongs to a chain of names that share the same stem, some of them the great ones of the Celtic world. Two inscriptions form the whole record for this god.

okr.objective: Document Mogetius, the Continental war god equated with Mars.
key_results: Record the two inscriptions that name the god.
Record the Roman equating with Mars.
